en: Changed `ultrathink` in the interactive terminal to run its turn at xhigh effort on Opus 5.5, Sonnet 5.5, Haiku 5.5 and Fable 5.1 through Anthropic's API; typed while Claude is working, it raises the rest of that turn
zh: 变更交互式终端中的 `ultrathink`，使其在 Opus 5.5、Sonnet 5.5、Haiku 5.5 和 Fable 5.1 上通过 Anthropic 的 API 以 xhigh 力度运行该轮；在 Claude 工作时输入，会提升该轮剩余部分的力度
